title: Apply API/Implementation Modules and Acyclic Dependency Graphs
prompt: Extract a Payments API and implementation, remove a cycle with Accounts, and add a graph rule that rejects feature-to-implementation dependencies.
successCriteria: Every important state and dependency has one named owner.
Dependencies point through the smallest consumer-facing contracts.
Tests, graph checks, or measurements cover the primary failure and change scenarios.
hints: Trace one user event end to end before drawing additional layers.
Remove any wrapper that cannot name the change, risk, or test seam it protects.
solutionOutline: Model behaviours, lifetimes, dependencies, and failure states first.
Implement the smallest boundary, compose it at the edge, and collect evidence.
verification: Run the focused behaviour or contract tests.
Inspect the dependency graph and repeat the adverse scenario after recreation or replacement.
